presentation.manual_preparation: Before first Play, copy your own supported original Japanese Doraemon: Nobita to 3tsu no Seireiseki .z64 ROM beside Dora64.exe and name that copy doraemon.n64.jp.z64. The named original ROM, saves folder, input/game/touch settings and named diagnostics live beside Dora64.exe and are declared for compatible updates and backup. Keep the source original elsewhere too. A differently named ROM or custom profile can use external registration. Runtime rollback carries current declared data without rewinding saves.
